text:
Predicates:
Nice(x, y) ::: x is nice to y.
Mean(x, y) ::: x is mean to y.
Grumpy(x) ::: x is a grumpy person.
AnimalLover(x) ::: x is an animal lover.
PetOwner(x) ::: x is a pet owner.
Animals ::: animals.
Premises:
∀x (Nice(x, Animals) → ¬Mean(x, Animals)) ::: No one nice to animals is also mean to animals.
∃x (Grumpy(x) ∧ Mean(x, Animals)) ::: Some grumpy people are mean to animals.
∀x (AnimalLover(x) → Nice(x, Animals)) ::: All animal
